rights_basis: Operator review for worldwide distribution with no per-country restriction (D030), same cut-offs as the 2026-09-23 English cohort (public-domain/audits/en-ko-parity-rights-framework-2026-09-23.json). Oscar Wilde died in 1900 and the work was first published in 1888. US: published in or before 1930, so outside the 95-year term (17 U.S.C. 304; 104A restoration also gives at most the remainder of that term). Japan: life+50 plus the 3,794-day wartime addition for Allied works ended by 2005 for authors who died by 1944, before the 2018 extension, and is not revived. Korea: life+50 before 2013 / Art. 3(4). Life+70 and life+80 countries (CO, GQ) expired at the latest by end-2024; Mexico treats authors who died before 1952 as public domain (docs/rights/pd-batch-2026-11-gutenberg.md). Scope is the exact Project Gutenberg plain-text file pinned by SHA-256, without the PG header, license, footer, volunteer credits or name.
